description: A React component for managing and displaying team information, including overview, members, permissions, and settings, with functionality for editing, adding, and deleting team members, as well as updating team configurations.

classes.name: TeamInfoView
classes.description: React functional component for viewing and editing team details, members, permissions, and settings, with state management and API interactions.

methods.name: getOrganizationModels
methods.description: Determines the list of models to display based on organization and user models, handling special cases like 'all-proxy-models'.

methods.name: fetchTeamInfo
methods.description: Fetches team information from backend API and updates state.

methods.name: handleMemberCreate
methods.description: Handles creation of a new team member via API call, updates state, and notifies parent.

methods.name: handleMemberUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating an existing team member via API call, updates state, and notifies parent.

methods.name: handleMemberDelete
methods.description: Prepares to delete a team member, opening confirmation modal.

methods.name: handleDeleteConfirm
methods.description: Confirms and executes deletion of a team member via API, updates state.

methods.name: handleTeamUpdate
methods.description: Handles updating team settings via API call, including validation and state updates.

methods.name: copyToClipboard
methods.description: Copies specified text to clipboard and shows visual feedback.
